greeting: Egameni likaYise, neloNyana, neloMoya oyiNgcwele. Amen. UYesu Kristu, owasithandayo waza wasikhulula ezonweni zethu, makabe nani nonke.
penitential: Nkosi, hamba nathi kule ndlela yosizi. (Nkosi, sicelele inceba.) Kristu, wena ungumthombo wethemba lethu. (Kristu, sicelele inceba.) Nkosi, wena uyamazi umntu ngamnye ngamagama. (Nkosi, sicelele inceba.)
psalm_response: Ndinoyolo isizwe esinyulwe nguYehova ukuba sibe lilifa lakhe.
homily:
Kukho imizuzu apho ubomi bubonakala ngathi buphila ngesantya esikhawulezayo, apho izinto esizithandayo, izicwangciso zethu, kunye neminqweno yethu ibonakala ikwindawo enye. Cinga ngaloo mzuzu xa uBenjamin Vo wayehlala phantsi, ejonge iimephu zeenqwelo-moya, okanye esenza ikhowudi yomdlalo wakhe kwikhompyutha yakhe. Wayengumfana owayenomdla ongapheliyo, esakha ikamva lakhe ngengqondo eqaqambileyo eyayikwazi ukubona ngaphaya kwento ebonwa ngamehlo. Wayethanda ukucacisa ngale ‘con chim airlines’ yakhe, ebonisa ukuba intliziyo yakhe yayingeyiyo nje eyobuchwephesha, kodwa eyayizaliswe lithemba elikhulu. UBen wayeyindoda encinci eyayikwazi ukuzibona iindiza zayo zibhabha ngaphaya kwamafu, njengokuba wayesoloko ecinga ngekamva elizele luvuyo.

Namhlanje, kwiNcwadi ka-Efese, uPawulos usikhumbuza inyaniso enzulu: 'In Christ we were also chosen, destined in accord with the purpose of the One who accomplishes all things.' (Kuye uKristu, senziwa ilifa, simiselwe ngokokuthanda kukaThixo). Le nyaniso isikhumbuza ukuba uBen, nangona iminyaka yakhe yayimfutshane, wayengowakhe uThixo ngaphambi kokuba umhlaba ubekho. Wayengumntwana owayephila ngoxolo lukaKristu. Wayengumfana owayephulaphula, owayenika, owayezama ukwenza uthando lube yinto ebonakalayo. 

KwiVangeli yanamhlanje kaLuka, uYesu uthi: 'Are not five sparrows sold for two small coins? Yet not one of them has escaped the notice of God. Even the hairs of your head have all been counted.' (Akukho nanye kubo elityalwe nguThixo). Lo mfanekiso weentaka ezincinci usixelela ukuba uThixo akajongi nje imihlaba okanye iinkwenkwezi; Ujonge umntu ngamnye. Ujonge wena, Alan. Ujonge wena, Thao. Ujonge wena, Ryan. Xa ucinga ngaloo mboniso kaBen esesemncinci, xa wayecinga ngokunika yonke imali yasebhange encinci yakhe ukuba incede umalume wakhe uWilliam, uyaqonda ukuba uThixo wayemazi uBen ngaphakathi nasezintliziyweni zakhe. Wayengazange ayiphule loo ngulube yemali, yayisengcamango yentliziyo yakhe emsulwa, kodwa loo nqaku lokuba umntwana omncane kangaka abe nomnqweno wokunikela ngayo yonke into yakhe ngaphandle kokubala kuyasityhilela ukuba intliziyo kaBen yayingenabuzoweni, yayizaliswe luthando olunyulu lukaThixo.

Masimi apha ixesha elincinci… Masicinge ngendlela ubomi bukaBen obabuzaliswe ngayo kukukhanya. Wayengumfana owayethanda ukuhleka, owayejonga uyise ngamehlo okumncoma, owayeyazi ukuba kuthetha ukuthini ukuba ngumntu owabelana ngovuyo nabanye. Wayengumntwana owayenovelwano olukhulu. Kwaye namhlanje, ndifuna ukuthetha nawe Alan, nawe Thao, nawe Ryan mfowethu omncane, ngendlela enyanisekileyo. Ndiyazi ukuba umthwalo wosizi uyamfulathela umntu ebusuku. Kukho imibuzo eza ithi, 'Kutheni?' Kukho amaxesha apho uzibuza ukuba ngaba kukhona na eninokukwenza ngcono. Ndifuna ukuba uphulaphule inyaniso kaThixo namhlanje, kwaye uyivule intliziyo yakho: akukho nqaku lokuthi uphosile okanye wenze kakubi. Ukugula akwanga kwenzeka ngenxa yezinto owazenzayo okanye ongazenzanga. UThixo akakubeki icala, kwaye noBen akakubeki icala kwaphelela. Masikhuphe lo mthwalo wokuzisola emajukujukwini eentliziyo zenu namhlanje. Awuphosanga nto. Ubenze konke okusemandleni enu ngothando olungapheliyo. Ezinye izinto kulo mhlaba zenzeka ngaphandle kolawulo lwethu, ngaphandle kokuba nabani na enze impazamo. Niyinyaniso, nithandwa nguThixo ngokupheleleyo.

UYesu uthi: 'Do not be afraid. You are worth more than many sparrows.' (Musani ukoyika). Eli lizwi aliyomthetho, liyisithembiso. UBen akalahlekanga; usebukhoneni obukhulu boMthombo wothando. Uthi xa ucinga ngaye, ucinga ngaloo ntwana enemfesane, umfana owayephethe ukukhanya okukhulu kangaka. UBen ukhangele phantsi kuwe Ryan, kwaye akakushiye. Xa udlala okanye ucinga ngekamva, yazi ukuba uBen ukuthembile, ukuthandile, kwaye usakuthanda kakhulu. Hamba ke namhlanje ukhululekile emthwalweni wokuzisola. Bamba isandla sikaYesu, uthembe ukuba uYisease usezintliziyweni zenu, kwaye uBen ulala ngokuthula ekhanyeni likaThixo, esikhangela sonke ngovuyo olungunaphakade. UBen usafundisa, usafunda, kwaye usathanda. Ubumsulwa bakhe, uthando lwakhe, kunye nalo mbono wakhe we-'con chim airlines'—zonke ezi zinto zihlala zikhanya phambi koThixo. UBen akakho nje kwimbali yenu; ukwikhona apho uThixo enza khona yonke into ibe ntsha. Uthando lwakho, Ben, lusaqhubeka luhamba emhlabeni, lusaqhubeka lukhanya, kwaye lusaqhubeka lukhumbuza wonke umntu okwaziyo ukuba uThixo uyamthanda umntwana wakhe ngaphezu kwayo yonke into. Hlalani neli themba. Hlalani nolu thando. UBen ukhona, uyaqhubeka, kwaye uya kuhlala ephila kuthando lukaThixo olungapheliyo. Amen.
spiritual_communion: Yesu wam, ndiyakholwa ukuba ukhona kwiSakramente eliNgcwele. Ndiyakuthanda ngaphezu kwayo yonke into, kwaye ndinqwenela ukukwamkela emphefumlweni wam. Ekubeni ndingenako ngoku ukukwamkela kwiSakramente, nceda uze kum ngomoya nangothando. Ndikwamkela njengokuba ukhona, kwaye ndizibophelela kuwe ngokupheleleyo. Ungaze undivumele ndahluke kuwe. Amen.
closing: Ngamana uThixo onamandla onke angasigcina ngoxolo lwakhe, kwaye uBen angasikhumbuza ngalo lonke ixesha ukuba sithandwa nguThixo. Amen.
standing_petitions: Sithandazela uBen nabo bonke abasishiyileyo, ukuze baphumle ekukhanyeni kukaKristu ngonaphakade.
Sithandazela bonke abasemlilweni wosizi, ukuze uThixo abathuthuzele abanike ithemba elingapheliyo.

readings.label: Isifundo sokuqala
readings.text: Bazalwana noodade bethu: Kuye uKristu senziwa ilifa, simiselwe ngokokuthanda kukaThixo, owenza yonke into ngokwecebo lakhe, ukuze sibe ludumo lozuko lwakhe, thina ebesithembe uKristu kuqala. Kuye nani, enivile ilizwi lenyaniso, iVangeli yosindiso lwenu, naza nakholwa kuye, natywinwa ngoMoya oyiNgcwele othenjisiweyo, ongumqondiso welifa lethu lokuqala, de kufike ukukhululwa kwabantu bakaThixo, kube ludumo lozuko lwakhe.

readings.label: Indumiso
readings.text: R. Ndinoyolo isizwe esinyulwe nguYehova ukuba sibe lilifa lakhe. Thokozani nina balungileyo ngenxa kaYehova; ukudunyiswa kufanelekile kwabanentliziyo ethe tye. Dumisani uYehova ngohadi; mbethe ngoluhadi lweentambo ezilishumi. R. Ndinoyolo isizwe esinyulwe nguYehova ukuba sibe lilifa lakhe. Kuba lilungile ilizwi likaYehova, kwaye yonke imisebenzi yakhe ithembekile. Uthanda ubulungisa nokulunga; umhlaba uzaliswe luthando lukaYehova. R. Ndinoyolo isizwe esinyulwe nguYehova ukuba sibe lilifa lakhe. Inoyolo intlanga enoYehova njengoThixo wayo, abantu abanyulelwe ukuba babe lilifa lakhe. UYehova ukhangele phantsi esuka ezulwini; uyabona bonke abantu. R. Ndinoyolo isizwe esinyulwe nguYehova ukuba sibe lilifa lakhe.

readings.label: IVangeli
readings.text: Ngelo xesha: Isihlwele esikhulu sasibuthene, kangangokuba babenyathelana. UYesu waqala ukuthetha kubafundi bakhe, wathi: 'Qaphelani igwele, elikukuzenzisa kwabaFarisi. Akukho nto ifihlakeleyo engezuvezwa, nento efihliweyo engezuaziwa. Ngoko ke konke enikuthethileyo ebumnyameni kuya kuviwa ekukhanyeni, nento eniyisebeze ngasemva kweengcango ezivaliweyo iya kumenyezelwa phezu kwezindlu. Ndithi kuni, bahlobo bam, musani ukuboyika abo babulala umzimba, kodwa emva koko bengenako ukwenza nto yimbi. Ndiza kunibonisa lowo nimoyikayo. Moyikeni lowo unamandla okubulala nokuphosa eGehena; ewe, ndithi kuni, moyikeni lowo. Akuthengiswa ntiyaka zintlanu ngemali encinci? Noko ke akukho nanye kubo elityalwe nguThixo. Kwanenwele zentloko yenu zibalwe zonke. Musani ukoyika. Nixabiseke ngaphezu kwentaka ezininzi.'

day: Friday of the Twenty-eighth Week in Ordinary Time

pet_prayers.text: Ben ơi, trong giấc ngủ anh Huy đã thấy Ben về thăm anh, trao cho anh lời cầu nguyện để hai anh em mình lại được tìm thấy nhau. Xin Chúa thương nhậm lời Ben, cho Ben được hưởng ngàn thu bình an bên Chúa. Nếu có thể, xin Ben lại ghé thăm anh trong những giấc mơ tiếp theo nhé, dù chỉ là một lời chào hay một nụ cười thân thương như ngày nào.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Ben, my sweet boy, I miss you so much. Thank you for visiting me and Chú Chris last night. He told me he saw you flying a helicopter—so free, joyful, and strong up there. Down here, Mom and I are crying more and more each day. A piece of my heart feels completely dead without you, Ben. Please watch over us, pray for your mom, your brother Ryan, and me, and give us the strength to keep going. We love you forever

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Today marks 100 days without you. Miss you a whole a lot Ben. Feel free to visit any time! See you around buddy! Love you!

Ben ơi, nay anh M đi xử lý hồ sơ ở Cam Ranh, đi ngang qua Cam Ranh Airport. Rồi cuộc nói chuyện về máy bay của Ben lại ùa về, nhớ nhiều kỷ niệm về Ben lắm ( anh M sẽ giữ kín kakaka). Quỷ nhỏ, tự nhiên nghĩ về mày buồn dễ sợ. Hãy đi đến những nơi mà Ben muốn nha và đừng quên là luôn nhớ về gia đình mình nhé, thương em trai nhiều. Giá như !!!!!!!!!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: What happened my son? It's been 3 months since you left us. Missing you so much my whole body aches. Mom cries every day now... What are we going to do now Ben?  Please pray for us.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text:
Hey Ben,

Rafael Rizzo and his little brother Ben really need your help right now. Please bless them with good health and give them the strength to get through this together. Please watch over Brandon and Flor's health, too.

I miss you a whole bunch. I know you're up in heaven watching over all of us. Whenever you're able to, stop by to visit, yeah? I love you and miss you so much!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text:
Hey Ben - Miss you a whole bunch. Crying all day yesterday, i hope today will be better. Please guide our family through this grief... There's a 14 year old boy that just left earth on August 12... His name is Phero Aden Vo - look for him, maybe you guys can be friends...

Please pray for me and mom to have good health and strength.

I love and miss you Ben
